changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE facility ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, facility_name VARCHAR(200), capacity INT, description VARCHAR(500), managed_by BIGINT, location VARCHAR(500), open_time TIMESTAMPTZ, close_time TIMESTAMPTZ, open_for_all BOOLEAN, tenant_id BIGINT NOT NULL, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES tenant (id), FOREIGN KEY (managed_by) REFERENCES users (id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE facility_registered_user ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT, facility_id BIGINT, created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id), FOREIGN KEY (facility_id) REFERENCES facility (id) );

changeSet.author: Arun
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE facility_booking ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, facility_id BIGINT, user_id BIGINT, status VARCHAR(200), admin_comment VARCHAR(500), created_by BIGINT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_by BIGINT, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id), FOREIGN KEY (facility_id) REFERENCES facility (id) );
